title: Residential Swimming Pool Maintenance 2026 Open Dataset & Engine (Volume, Chlorine/pH/Salt HOCl Chemistry, Filtration & Heat Pump)
description: Open 2026 reference datasets (JSON/CSV) and zero-dependency ESM JavaScript calculation formulas published by CalculPiscine (calculpiscine.com) for France, Belgium, Switzerland, and Quebec (SISPEA water tariffs, EDF Tarif Bleu electricity rates). Covers pool volume by geometry (https://calculpiscine.com/volume/fond-compose/), water treatment dosing for chlorine, pH, and salt (https://calculpiscine.com/dosage-eau/), green-water shock recovery (https://calculpiscine.com/dosage/eau-verte/), filtration sizing, and heat pump power estimation.
